about_the_game:
Boundy is a game where a ball bounces endlessly as you aim higher and higher or race to reach the end of each stage. Clear every level by overcoming tricky challenges—whether it’s falling from a bad landing or being launched away by obstacles!

Perilous Terrain and Traps

Even moving forward won’t be easy. Every leap from platform to platform demands precision, while sudden traps try to knock your ball away. Stay sharp and survive the hazards!

Items Used at the Right Moment

You can beat the game without items, but you don’t have to make it harder than it needs to be. Collect items scattered throughout the stages and use them wisely in the moments that matter most.

Special Platforms with Unique Effects

Some platforms grant special effects the moment you touch them. Jump higher, fly farther, or bounce in unexpected directions—use these powers to push past obstacles and keep moving forward.
